name: Acuity Scheduling
tagline: Acuity Scheduling is an online appointment scheduling tool that lets clients book time with you 24/7. It syncs with your calendar, sends automatic reminders, collects intake forms, and processes payments — eliminating back-and-forth emails. Widely used by coaches, therapists, photographers, and other service businesses.
